title: Page 32 Closures and Acquisition Boundaries
purpose: Publish reviewed evidence packages for five historical null, negative, and correction runs while preserving their exact claim boundaries.
selection_notes: Selected because each conclusion is bounded and understandable.
Original nested ZIP identity and size are recorded in each Run.
Public packages preserve reviewed evidence but exclude full rune transcription and forward next-slice instructions.

E1607 through E1609 have independent public ledger reproductions; E1606 is partial because the original model implementation is absent; E1605 is historical-only because the network environment is not reconstructed.
release_notes: Published through the main-branch Research Archive as a portable public download. This source publication does not imply a separately tagged GitHub Release or a Patreon attachment.
